name: Numerical protection relay (IED)
summary: Single relay block on an SLD that lists the protection functions it provides, with CT, VT and trip connections.
description: A numerical protection relay, or IED, combines many protection, control and measuring functions in one device. Single-line diagrams draw it as a block connected to its CTs, VTs and breaker trip coil, with the enabled functions listed inside or beside it using IEC function symbols or ANSI device numbers.

Listing a function on the block shows it is enabled, not how it is set. The block does not show settings, logic between functions, or communications, so it must be read with the settings file and the protection logic diagram.
readingNotes: Read the function list as enabled functions, not settings.
Trace CT, VT and trip connections to the block.
drawingChecklist: Show CT, VT and trip connections
distinction: An IED block represents a multifunction device; a single measuring relay symbol represents one function.
